description: Prepare a QWallet withdrawal: EIP-712 typed data for the owner wallet plus the exact message for the owner's SLH-DSA key, valid 15 minutes. Both signatures are required on-chain; recipient, asset and amount are bound. Never signs or sends.

amount.description: Raw integer units of the asset (USDG has 6 decimals; ETH 18).

asset.description: ETH (native) or an ERC-20 address in the pool policy.

chain.description: Robinhood Chain (4663). Other chains use qhooks.com/qwallets in a browser.

dryRun.description: Return a plan and simulation without storing preparation state.

publicKey.description: The owner's SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s public key (32 bytes, 0x-hex). Generated and kept by the agent; never send a secret key.

tokens.description: ERC-20 asset policy fixed at pool deployment. Default: [USDG]. Pass the same list for every later call on that pool.

name: prepare_qwallet_withdraw
title: Prepare a QWallet withdrawal
